title.narrative: Yemen Financial Market Infrastructure and Inclusion Project

description.narrative: The Project's Development Objective is to develop a payment infrastructure that supports the efficiency of payment transactions in Yemen and increases financial inclusion.

The project will support the enhancement of the payments infrastructure in Yemen and will include 4 components focused on developing the payments infrastructure and supporting the digitization of payments in Yemen:• Component 1: Development of Fast Payment Systems (FPS) • Component 2: Development of a Real Time Gross Settlement System (RTGS) for Yemen and upgrading of the Core Banking System for CBY-Aden • Component 3: Supporting access and usage of the payment's infrastructure• Component 4: Project Management
